author: resepignev
body:
Heey resepignev here,

Today I can release map, that you'll like. It has two new feature, wich is only to find in Axis (not in the rotations. You can find them in the "Details" beyond in the main Map description.

Actyon

Title: Actyon
Created By: resepignev
Game: Nebula (DTM)
Teams: Pred (Red) and Y
Details: This map changes gameplay. It has two new features: Jumppads, the only way how you can get to the other side (Or you just bridge to the other side, but the jumppad is faster and cooler). The second amazing feature is the Kitselection in the pre-spawn. This means, you'll spawn in a room, there you can select your kit (Tank, Archer, Scout) and then you'll teleported onto the main map. The teleport point is 10 blocks  above the ground. (It prevents spawnkilling)
There are 2 monuments and the team size is small, only 16 vs 16 people.
Download: I work on it right now :D
Pictures: http://imgur.com/a/bn08S
YML: I work on it right now :D
Screenshots:
